why_choose.title: Why choose Musicdibs?
why_choose.subtitle: Register, distribute and monetize your songs in minutes. Generate real income with the fastest and most accessible digital solution created for independent artists.
why_choose.feature1_description: International legal validity backed by blockchain
why_choose.feature1_modal: Each registration in Musicdibs generates an immutable digital certificate backed by Blockchain technology, valid as legal proof of authorship. This certificate complies with international and national regulations, including the Berne Convention, the WIPO Treaty, the Digital Copyright Directive and regulations on Blockchain applied to intellectual property.
why_choose.feature2_description: Protect your work in seconds, not weeks. WITHOUT bureaucracy.
why_choose.feature2_modal: Instant protection, without complications. Forget about paperwork and slow, expensive processes. With Musicdibs, registering your music is as easy as uploading your file: in just seconds we generate a unique digital fingerprint, and register it on blockchain with international legal validity. Without intermediaries and for a fraction of the cost of a traditional registration.
why_choose.feature3_description: Launch on all digital platforms. EARN royalties
why_choose.feature3_modal: Worldwide Distribution. Launch your music on the most important digital platforms in the world: Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, YouTube Music and many more, up to 220. Earn royalties from the first stream and make your talent cross borders without intermediaries or hidden commissions. Control everything from a single platform, with real-time statistics and personalized support.
why_choose.feature4_description: Register and sell your AI creations
why_choose.feature4_modal: No Censorship. No limits. Only creative freedom. At Musicdibs we believe that art should have no borders. That's why we accept registrations of works generated with artificial intelligence or experimental, without restrictions or filters, as long as you have all the rights to them and they are not plagiarized.
